{{Infobox Item |image= {{Media |Model BotW= [[File:BotW Traveler's Claymore Model.png|320x320px]] |Model TotK= [[File:TotK Traveler's Claymore Model.png|320x320px]] |Sprite BotW= [[File:BotW Traveler's Claymore Icon.png|320x320px]] |Sprite TotK= [[File:TotK Traveler's Claymore Icon.png|320x320px]] }} |caption= |game= BotW, TotK |other= AoC |cost= |value= |location= {{Spawn Locations}} |uses= Attacking [[Enemy|Enemies]] |strength= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= 10 |TotK= 6 }} |durability= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= 20 |TotK= 16 }} |comp= [[Traveler's Claymore✨|Traveler's Claymore]][[File:ZW TotK Intact Weapon.png|x16px|link=Traveler's Claymore✨]] |sample= |theme= }} {{Term/Store|Traveler's Claymore|Traveler's Claymores|Series, BotW, TotK, AoC|plural}} are recurring [[Item]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Exp Game|BotW, TotK, AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 10 |durability = 20 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Traveler's Claymore}} Traveler's Claymores are two-handed [[Weapon]]s commonly used by aspiring adventurers. They are hefty enough to knock the [[Shield]] out of [[Enemy|Enemies]]' hands. These Claymores can be found abandoned in [[Hyrule Field]] and [[West Necluda]]. They are also carried by the [[Swordswoman Statue|Swordswomen Statues]] in the [[Gerudo Desert]]. When scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]], the following [[amiibo]] have a chance to spawn a [[Treasure Chest]] containing a Traveler's Claymore: * {{SSB|-}} Series [[Young Link]] amiibo * {{SSB|-}} Series [[Ganondorf]] amiibo * {{TLoZ|-}} Series [[Link]] ({{LA}}) amiibo * {{TLoZ|-}} Series [[Link]] ({{OoT}}) amiibo * {{TLoZ|-}} Series Young Link ({{MM}}) amiibo * {{BotW|-}} Series [[Daruk]] amiibo Traveler's Claymores, since they are made of metal, will attract [[Lightning]] when equipped during [[Thunderstorm]]s and conduct [[Electricity]]. However, they will sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. They can be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] Rune, and they will not burn if they are exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. Traveler's Claymores belong to the [[Traveler's Gear]] archetype of Weapons, which is used for defense by the travelers of [[Hyrule]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Lsword_001" |Life = 20 |Power = 10 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 5 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 3 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 6 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 9 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 4 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 4 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 0.7 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 8 |BuyingPrice = 30 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Two-Handed Weapon |strength = 6 |durability = 16 |flammable = no |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = |throw = |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Traveler's Claymore}} {{Stub|TotK}} Traveler's Claymores appear in {{TotK}}. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Link Two-Handed Weapon }} {{Stub|AoC}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== {{All Images}} File:BotW Blue and Red Bokoblins.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Link wielding a Traveler's Claymore File:AoC Traveler's Claymore Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for the Traveler's Claymore ==See Also== {{See Also| * Decayed Weapon * Traveler's Claymore✨ * Traveler's Gear * Two-Handed Weapon * Weapon }} {{Ref| {{Cite|{{Big|Traveler's Claymore}}
